description.value: At 3rd level, the medic can cure conditions and status effects. The medic can make a Heal check that takes a minute to cure the status, or use Treatment as part of a triage as a free action, bypassing the normal time. Conditions are ranked Minor (DC 15: Blinded, Fatigued, Shaken, Sickened), Major (DC 20: Dazed, Diseased, Enfeebled, Silenced, Staggered), Severe (DC 25: Confused, Exhausted, Frightened, Immobilized, Nauseated, Petrification, Poisoned, Slow), and Dire (DC 30: Berserk, Deafened, Disabled, Paralyzed, Sapped, Statue, Stunned, Zombie). The medic cannot take 10 or 20 on the check or receive aid except from another medic. Failure by 5 or less transfers the condition to the medic for the remaining duration; failure by 10 or more inflicts it on both. The medic cannot cure conditions on herself. At 5th level, the medic can heal minor conditions without a Heal check. At 9th level, she cures major conditions without a roll and can cure diseases (not just the condition) via triage with a Heal check equal to double the disease's Save DC. At 13th level, she cures severe conditions without a roll and can cure poisons the same way. At 17th level, she cures dire conditions without a roll.
